name: Recruiter — active candidate
description: For people who are visibly looking. Faster than the passive sequence, leads with the role, and asks for a call by the second message because their attention is finite and contested.
audience: Open-to-work badge, recent redundancy post, "currently exploring" headline, or applicants who went quiet.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — saw you're open to what's next. I'm recruiting for a {{title|role}} that looks close to your background. Connecting so I can send the detail.
{{firstName|Hi}} — I have a live brief that lines up with your experience at {{company|your last company}}. Happy to send it over if you connect.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. The short version: {{title|the role}}-level, product team of about 40, hybrid, and they move fast on decisions. Want the full brief and the salary band?
Here's the honest summary, {{firstName|there}}: strong team, messy legacy stack, genuine autonomy, band is competitive. Shall I send the full spec?
{{firstName|Hi}} — do you have 15 minutes this week? Faster for me to answer your questions live than to guess which ones matter.
Worth a quick call, {{firstName|there}}? 15 minutes and you'll know whether this is a yes or a no. I'd rather you decided fast either way.
Last nudge, {{firstName|there}} — they're interviewing this week. Say the word and I'll get you in; otherwise I'll close this off and keep you in mind for the next one.
{{firstName|Hi}} — I'll assume this one isn't right and stop. Tell me what you actually want next and I'll only come back when I have it.
